description:
Share Lending, LEND side: the Morpho Vault V2 that lends USDG against Hedgehood fund shares (hhNVDA-CC) on Morpho Blue — vault,
        total assets, cap and room, the live market's utilization and borrow rate, an approximate supply APY (net of the vault's 10%
        performance fee), and `my`: the account's vault shares, their USDG value and its wallet USDG. Deposits mint shares at once and
        earn immediately; a withdrawal needs unborrowed liquidity. Read-only; nothing is sent. Not for US persons.
name: lend_status
